instruction: Review reminder.docx on the desktop. In the Sorghum sheet, calculate the average of the first 5 months (Jan-May 2010) of Gotheye Sorghum prices using an AVERAGE formula in cell B7.

metadata.explanation: Task requires AVERAGE formula for first 5 months of Gotheye Sorghum. Verified with Python: average of B2:B6 (157, 173, 189, 303.03, 241.24) = 212.654. Note: Original B7 contains data, but task asks to replace with formula.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical requirement missing: Instruction explicitly requires 'using an AVERAGE formula' but evaluator only checks the computed cell value, not the formula itself
Getter uses openpyxl with data_only=True which loads only calculated values, not formulas - cannot distinguish between manual entry '212.654' vs formula '=AVERAGE(B2:B6)'
Evaluator would incorrectly pass if user manually types 212.654 instead of entering the required AVERAGE formula
Expected value 212.654 is semantically correct based on the data (average of 157, 173, 189, 303.03, 241.24)
Postconfig correctly saves the file before verification, ensuring fresh state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change getter to use openpyxl with data_only=False to access cell formulas, not just values
Modify getter to extract both cell.value (the formula string like '=AVERAGE(B2:B6)') and check if it starts with '=' and contains 'AVERAGE'
Add metric logic to verify: (1) cell contains a formula, (2) formula is AVERAGE type, (3) formula references correct range B2:B6, (4) calculated result matches expected value
Alternative: Use two-stage verification - first check formula existence/type, then check computed value with tolerance
